desc: Experience comprehensive eye protection with ULTRX Fit Over Safety Glasses. Designed to fit comfortably over prescription eyewear, these clear safety glasses are ideal for a wide range of environments, from shooting ranges to construction sites and DIY projects. Featuring high-impact, anti-scratch polycarbonate lenses and a large-sized lens for full visibility, they ensure clarity and durability. The vented temples enhance airflow to reduce fogging, making them perfect for extended use. Elevate your safety gear with ULTRX Fit Over Safety Glasses, where superior protection meets exceptional comfort.
